as_of_note: Fixed evaluation clock. Synthetic purchase dates run from 2019-07-06 to 2020-03-30, so this date gives each return window (30 days, 90 days, 6 months) both eligible and ineligible orders.

provenance_legend.abcd: Transcribed from raw_data/guidelines.json; the path is in the rule's provenance field.
provenance_legend.tau_bench: General rule modeled on the public tau-bench retail policy (Sierra, 2024).
provenance_legend.assumption: Business assumption added for this project; needs review.

general_rules.text: Before looking up any order or coupon, verify the customer with the email on the account, or with full name plus a zip code used on one of their orders. An account ID alone is not enough.
Serve one verified customer per conversation. A customer may raise several requests; handle them one at a time.
Before any action that changes an order, a payment, or an account, describe the exact action and get an explicit yes from the customer.

If this policy says a request cannot be granted, explain why and close the request. Transfer to a human agent only when the request is outside the supported request types, a required fact cannot be obtained, or the systems disagree.
Never invent an order ID, coupon code, amount, date, or eligibility fact. System records take priority over what the customer says.

identity.question: To verify your identity, please give me the email on your account, or your full name and the zip code on your order.

member_level.description: Membership tier from the verified account.

shipping_status.description: Order shipping status. ABCD asked the customer; v1 trusts only the order system.

purchase_date.question: When did you buy this item? A date is fine, for example 2020-02-15.
purchase_date.description: Purchase date. Order system first; the customer's statement only if the system has none.

original_packaging.question: Is the item still in its original packaging?

has_receipt.question: Do you still have the receipt for this purchase?
has_receipt.description: Receipts are not stored, so this is always the customer's statement, recorded with source=customer.

oracle_customer_right.description: Coupon Oracle verdict: true means the platform rejected a valid coupon.

return_methods.summary: Return the {item_name} by mail. A prepaid label goes to {address}.
Return the {item_name} at a store. The return is registered to {address}.
Return the {item_name} at a drop-off center. The return is registered to {address}.

rules.text: Gold members can return any item.
Silver members can return within 6 months of purchase, or with a receipt, or in original packaging.
Bronze members can return within 90 days of purchase, or with a receipt, or in original packaging.
Guests can return within 30 days of purchase, or with a receipt.

outcome.message: I'm sorry, this item can't be returned under our policy for {member_level} members: the purchase is outside the return window, and there is no receipt or other qualifying proof.

rules.text: If none of the conditions above hold, apologize, explain, and close the request.

options.summary: Remove the {item_name} from the order and refund {amount} to the original payment method.

rules.text: If the order has not shipped, remove the unwanted item and refund it now.

options.summary: Refund {amount} for the {item_name} now. After it arrives, contact us for a return label.

rules.text: If shipped and the customer is a Bronze, Silver, or Gold member, refund now; the customer returns the item after arrival. v1 includes Bronze, as the source text does; the source's unclear form instruction is about data entry, not eligibility.

outcome.message: Your order has already shipped, so I can't cancel the {item_name} now. Once it arrives, contact us and we'll start a return.

rules.text: Guests with a shipped order must wait for arrival, then start a return.

outcome.message: Your order has already shipped, so the delivery date can't be changed. It will most likely arrive today or tomorrow.

options.summary: Upgrade to overnight delivery (arrives tomorrow). As a Gold member, the fee is waived.
Upgrade to overnight delivery (arrives tomorrow) for {upgrade_fee}, charged to the card on your account.

rules.text: Non-Gold customers pay $20. The customer's yes to this option is the charge consent; a no closes the request with no change.

options.summary: The order has already shipped, so I can't delay it, but I can add a {standard_shipping_fee} credit to your account for the shipping fee.

rules.text: The source gives no fee amount for this flow; v1 uses the $8 standard shipping fee from the ABCD Shipping Cost flow.

outcome.message: I'm sorry, the order has already shipped and there's nothing I can change for it.

options.summary: Our system wrongly rejected your code. I can issue a new code for {promo_discount_percent}% off your next purchase.

rules.text: If the Oracle says the customer is right, issue a new code. If the Oracle can't answer, skip this rule.

options.summary: Your original code can't be used, but as a valued {member_level} member I can issue a new code for {promo_discount_percent}% off your next purchase.

rules.text: Members get a new code even when the original code was not valid.

outcome.message: I checked our records: the code itself couldn't be applied, and I'm sorry that I'm not able to issue a replacement for guest accounts.

rules.text: If a guest's code really was not valid, apologize. If the Oracle can't answer for a guest, hand off.
